description: This file defines the class LoggerDefaultCategoryFactory, which extends LoggerFactory, and provides a method to create new Logger instances by name. It is part of the log4php logging framework's factory implementation.

classes.name: LoggerDefaultCategoryFactory
classes.description: A factory class to instantiate Logger objects with specific names within the log4php framework.

methods.name: makeNewLoggerInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Logger object with the specified name.
